evidence.name: Screen field: Color of typed answers
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Color of typed answers" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Color of typed answers
sections.description: Sets the color of the text a visitor types into this field; the gray placeholder hint has its own separate color. Pick a color with strong contrast against the field background (use a light color on dark themes) so answers stay legible. Easy-to-read fields are easier to fill in, which protects completion on your data-collection screens.
